cn.assets.binding.roleHint: 先选择角色，再选择当前节点下匹配的网络实例。
cn.assets.binding.empty: 当前节点没有符合条件的网络实例。
cn.assets.binding.noSelectable: 当前实例暂不可绑定，请查看各实例的原因。
cn.assets.binding.requestFailed: 无法读取实例资料，请手动重试。
cn.assets.binding.legacyHint: 这是未绑定的旧资料。原地址继续保留，补绑前请核对新旧信息。
cn.assets.binding.fixedHint: 已保存的节点、网关归属和实例保持固定；核对只采纳同一实例的当前配置。
cn.assets.binding.inherited: 沿用所属网关的网络实例
cn.assets.binding.parentRequired: 所属网关尚未完成有效绑定，请先在网关管理中补绑或核对。
cn.assets.binding.previewRequired: 请先预览当前选择，再确认保存。
cn.assets.binding.previewFailed: 无法生成当前预览，请核对选择后重试。
cn.assets.binding.applyFailed: 保存失败，请保留输入并重试。
cn.assets.binding.generationChanged: 实例已重新创建。本次确认将采纳新的配置来源，下挂设备仍需分别核对。
cn.assets.binding.childrenHint: 保存网关配置不会自动覆盖下挂设备的地址。
cn.assets.binding.newIpv4Only: 新绑定和地址生成使用 IPv4；旧 IPv6 资料在转换前保持原样。
cn.assets.binding.hostHint: 根据所选网段填写主机部分，完整地址以预览结果为准。
cn.assets.binding.selfLan: 登记网关本机的内网 IP（选填）
cn.assets.binding.selfHint: 本机组网 IP 使用实例地址；填写内网 IP 时，只按真实内网网段生成。
cn.assets.binding.addressSource: 地址来自绑定实例及选定规则
cn.assets.binding.state.replaced: 实例已重建 · 待核对
cn.assets.binding.readonlyAddresses: 地址由实例和规则生成，修改请使用独立的地址核对操作。
cn.assets.binding.scopeChanged: 当前账号或节点已变化，请重新打开窗口。

en.assets.binding.roleHint: Choose a role, then a matching network instance on this node.
en.assets.binding.empty: This node has no matching network instances.
en.assets.binding.noSelectable: No instance can be bound yet. Review the reasons below.
en.assets.binding.requestFailed: Unable to load instances. Please retry manually.
en.assets.binding.legacyHint: This existing record is not bound. Its addresses are preserved; review the old and new values before binding.
en.assets.binding.fixedHint: The saved node, gateway and instance remain fixed. Review adopts the current configuration of the same instance.
en.assets.binding.inherited: Using the parent gateway's network instance
en.assets.binding.parentRequired: The parent gateway needs a valid binding. Bind or review it in gateway management first.
en.assets.binding.previewRequired: Preview the current selection before saving.
en.assets.binding.previewFailed: Unable to preview. Review your selection and retry.
en.assets.binding.applyFailed: Unable to save. Your input is preserved for retry.
en.assets.binding.generationChanged: The instance was recreated. Confirming adopts its new configuration source; child devices still require individual review.
en.assets.binding.childrenHint: Saving gateway configuration does not overwrite child device addresses.
en.assets.binding.newIpv4Only: New bindings and derived addresses use IPv4. Existing IPv6 records remain unchanged until converted.
en.assets.binding.hostHint: Enter the host part for the selected subnet. The preview shows the complete addresses.
en.assets.binding.selfLan: Record the gateway's own LAN IP (optional)
en.assets.binding.selfHint: The gateway uses the instance overlay IP. Its optional LAN address uses the real subnet only.
en.assets.binding.addressSource: Addresses come from the bound instance and selected rule
en.assets.binding.readonlyAddresses: These addresses come from the instance and rules. Use the separate address review action to change them.
en.assets.binding.scopeChanged: The current account or node changed. Reopen this window.
